🎨 Brand Assets

Upload your logo, payment QR, and signatures as image files — no more pasting code. These sync to all your devices automatically. PNG with transparent background works best for logos and signatures. Keep each image reasonably small (under ~400 KB) for fast syncing.
📍 Address Options
Two switchable GSTIN + address blocks — pick which one prints per document from the dropdown near the top of the editor. Company name/branding stays the same for both.

🛟 Data & Sync

The app automatically snapshots each collection before it gets overwritten. If something disappeared, restore it here.

Note: snapshots live in this browser's storage, so they cannot survive clearing browser/site data. For that, use the full backup below and keep the file somewhere safe.

💰 Check Advance Pool

Look up anyone's advance pool by name — they don't need to be a registered repeat client. If there are multiple people with this name, you'll be asked which documents actually belong to them.

⚠️ Review Uncertain Matches

These documents have the same name as , but a different or missing phone number — so they might be a different person. Tick any that are genuinely the same person to include them.

Contract Progress

📦 Stock Manager

📊 Bought / Sold / Stock
Sold counts Tax Invoices only, minus Credit Notes. Enter what's actually at site below to see any mismatch (breakage, miscounts).
💥 What the mismatch costs
Counted shortfalls valued at landing cost. Surplus is reported separately and never netted off — extra 4 inch blocks do not pay for broken 8 inch ones.
🕰️ How long stock has been sitting
Only batches with quantity still on hand. Anything over 60 days is listed individually.
Detail by location & landing cost
Quantities shown are current stock remaining across all batches at each location.
💡 Just the date, item, and quantity is enough to log stock — cost is optional. If you want margin tracking on this batch, tap "Add landing cost details" below to enter the trip's transport/unloading cost once and have each line's landing cost calculated automatically.
⚡ Quick Entry — quantities only
Pick the brand once, then type how many of each size arrived. Leave a size blank if none came.

Moves stock from one location to another at the SAME landing cost — e.g. 200 blocks sent from Stockyard to Site 1.
Bringing unused stock back increases its landing cost due to the extra handling — e.g. 50 blocks unused out of 200 sent to Site 1, returning to Stockyard with added transport/loading cost.
v78: New Tax Invoices now link automatically the moment they're saved — you shouldn't need this tab day to day. It's here to backfill Tax Invoices that were saved before auto-linking existed. Search below, choose a location, confirm.
🚚 Freight charged vs freight paid
Charged is the transport lines on Tax and Sales Invoices, net of GST and discount. Paid is the transport recorded on purchase batches.
Non-sellable equipment (angle grinder, ladder, hammer, spirit level...). Just tracks which site each tool is currently at — no cost, no batches.

👥 Client Directory

Every client is assigned a permanent ID the first time they appear on a saved document. Click a row to filter the Cloud Document Manager down to just their documents, or use Edit to update their details.
ID Name Phone GSTIN Docs Actions

🔄 Register Repeat Clients

These names appear on INV/SAL/ADV documents but aren't registered clients yet. Tick who you want to convert to a repeat client — this only registers who you select, nothing else changes. Ticking someone assigns the next C-number and tags all their matching documents automatically.

Edit Client

⚠️ REASSIGN CLIENT ID — Admin Action
Updates the ID in the directory AND re-tags all their saved documents. Use to fix sync conflicts where two clients share the same C#.

💰 Check Advance Pool

Look up anyone's advance balance without registering them as a repeat client — useful for a one-time or occasional customer. Matches by name AND phone number together, since two different people can share a name.
